details: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decided at its March 17-18, 2026 meeting to keep the federal funds target range unchanged at 3.50% to 3.75%. This decision reflects the Fed's view of continued economic resilience and persistent inflation, leading to expectations that interest rates will remain elevated through 2026. This "higher for longer" monetary policy stance creates headwinds for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, by increasing the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets.
title: Federal Reserve Maintains Rates, Signalling 'Higher for Longer' Stance

details: Iran has announced the full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz for commercial vessels, easing immediate fears of an energy supply shock. However, President Donald Trump has vowed to maintain a US naval blockade on Iranian ships and ports, keeping oil and crypto markets on edge. This mixed signal has led to oil prices dropping over 10% on the news, as partial relief for supply concerns emerges. Bitcoin's price has shown volatility, oscillating in response to these geopolitical headlines, reflecting its role as a geopolitical hedge.
title: Strait of Hormuz Reopens, Oil Prices Drop Amid US Naval Blockade Uncertainty

details: A recent study by Citi indicates that combining Bitcoin with gold in investment portfolios has significantly improved returns over the past decade without escalating risk. The analysis suggests a diversified approach leveraging both digital and traditional assets offers better returns and risk management, particularly in volatile macroeconomic environments. The report, cited by CNBC, notes that Bitcoin often outperforms gold when bond markets are weak, and a 5% allocation split between gold and Bitcoin further enhances portfolio efficiency.
title: Citi Study: Bitcoin and Gold Enhance Portfolio Returns Without Increasing Risk
